ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point O is on line AB, $\angle COE$ is a right angle, OF bisects $\angle AOE$, $\angle COF=30^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle EOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given, $\because$ $\angle COE$ is a right angle,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle COE=90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle COE=\angle COF+\angle FOE$, $\angle COF=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle FOE=\angle COE−\angle COF=90^\circ−30^\circ=\boxed{60^\circ}$,\\
$\because$ OF bisects $\angle AOE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle FOE=\angle AOF=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOE=2\angle FOE=120^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle AOE+\angle BOE=180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOE=180^\circ−120^\circ=60^\circ$
